key.name: restore-session
key.description: Reopen apps that were open in the last session and put their windows back where they were.

key.name: ignored-apps
key.description: Desktop app IDs (e.g. slack_slack.desktop) that are never launched by session restore. Their windows are still placed if they open.

key.name: launch-delay
key.summary: Seconds after login before reopening apps
key.description: Gives autostart apps time to open first, so they aren't launched twice.

key.name: docked-size-percent
key.summary: Size of windows moved to an external monitor for the first time
key.description: Percentage of the primary monitor's width and height, for windows with no saved position in a setup when monitors are connected.

key.name: settle-delay
key.summary: Seconds to wait for monitors to settle after a change
key.description: Docks often apply several monitor configurations in a row when plugged in. Layouts are not saved until the monitors have been stable this long. 0 measures it automatically.

key.name: recent-settle-ms
key.description: Written by the extension: how long the last monitor changes took to settle, in milliseconds.

key.name: notified-issues
key.description: Written by the extension so the same compatibility warning isn't shown at every login.

key.name: debug-logging
key.description: Log restore decisions to the GNOME Shell journal.
